_about: Central style registry. One entry per style: n (gallery order), engine, group, label, desc (what it looks like), best_for (intended use), uses (storyboard fields it reads), music (default bed), assets, sample, example_storyboard, source, and optional qc_not_applied ({check: reason}) for quality checks that do not fit the style's design. docs/styles.md is generated from this file: run `python3 video.py styles-doc` after editing. `default` is the style `video.py script` uses when --style is not given.
